title: P0 P1 单变量可观测性与隐藏状态联合概率估计
scope: only stationary state recovery and calibration; no changed edge, no warning experiment, no P2-P4
delay_definition: same delay d=1,2,3 per causal edge; earliest Y-to-X influence 2d time steps
noise: independent Gaussian; generator innovation variances .25 each; observation std .05,.25,.75; physical latent noise amplitudes withheld from learners
design: one-factor-at-a-time 11 cells plus two preregistered interaction endpoints, not full243 factorial

per_cell_seed.evaluation_times: 50 through498 for states/forecasts, exclude startup and final boundary

A: unknown physical structure: X-only Gaussian AR order selected from1,5,20,40 on validation; predictive history state, refuse named physical Y/Z claims
B: assumed positive Y->Z->x chain; all dynamic coefficients, x process noise and measurement noise unknown; unit latent innovation covariance is coordinate gauge, not physical noise knowledge; fit Gaussian block40 composite likelihood with analytic gradients 4 L-BFGS-B starts max180 steps; select start by exact validation sequence likelihood
C: Oracle knows true equations and parameters, still only observes same X; prior/current-X/filter/smoother separately labelled; smoother uses future
timing_ambiguity: pure stationary Gaussian cascade delay does not alter X distribution; fit canonical delay1, output equally observationally compatible delay1/2/3 filters without true-delay selection; do not assign prior-free posterior over physical timing
legacy: preserve original L1 data/checkpoints unchanged; frozen encoder plus new X-only probability head using learned SSM posterior pseudo-targets and conditional covariance; no legacy true-state readouts loaded
scale: primary hidden targets evaluated in canonical innovation units Y/sqrt(qY), Z/sqrt(qZ) using answers only after freeze; physical amplitudes not claimed identifiable
probability_metrics: marginal PIT and descriptive KS distance
posterior covariance and oracle innovation floor
independence: train/validation/test separated by independent trajectories; evaluation truth never used for alignment, calibration, thresholds or model selection; no posthoc truth-based linear alignment as primary
parameter_uncertainty: baseline/rich/poor only:12 trajectory bootstrap refits from selected estimate, max120 iterations; moment-matched Gaussian, conditional on delay1; not a Bayesian posterior, not complete timing uncertainty

conditional_probability_gate.require: each of three seeds in both baseline and rich conditions
conditional_probability_gate.hidden_dimension_requirement: joint2D covariance maintained; no duplicated deterministic coordinates

physical_P2_gate: conditional metrics must pass AND physical state identity and delay must be identifiable within compatible X-only models; no green light merely for good coverage
statistics: per-trajectory metrics plus three independent-fit seed summaries; hierarchical paired bootstrap seeds then trajectories2000 replicates; intervals descriptive with only3 independent fits; no IID timepoint inference
theory: finite-horizon dimensionless observability singular values separate from stochastic posterior uncertainty; complete deterministic rank is not stochastic recovery; exact X-law delay equivalence and scale invariance controls
literature: attachment references guide motivation only; no claim of reproducing their methods or novelty priority
